title: Discrete Temporal CSPs et al
summary: We revisit the complexity classification of constraint satisfaction problems (CSPs) for first-order reducts of $(\mathbb{Z},<)$, established by Bodirsky, Martin, and Mottet in 2018. Following their approach, we give a self-contained proof of this classification, correcting several errors in the argument. We further show that, with the exception of cases arising from finite-domain CSPs, all tractable cases are solved by a well-known uniform algorithm, eliminating the need for the collection of ad-hoc algorithms used in the original paper.
